title: Traveling For 20 Dollars a Day: Guangzhou, China - Ep 23
description:
In Guangzhou China, we ate loads of dim sum, explored the old area of Guangzhou and had a really fun day, thanks to my friend and local guide, Fei! Also, things got a little weird when fellow restaurant goers offer us some strange home-brewed alcohol.
